content: Constellation Energy Corporation is the largest producer of carbon-free energy in the United States and a leading supplier of energy products and services. Headquartered in Baltimore, the company operates the nation's largest fleet of nuclear power plants, providing reliable, emission-free electricity to millions of homes and businesses. Constellation is a critical player in the transition to a clean energy economy, leveraging its diverse generation portfolio—including hydro, wind, and solar—to help customers meet their sustainability goals while maintaining grid reliability and energy security across the country.

Officers

Joseph Dominguez(Date: 2022 February)

President and Chief Executive Officer

Joseph Dominguez is president and chief executive officer of Constellation. He previously served as CEO of ComEd from 2018 to 2022 and as executive vice president of governmental and regulatory affairs and public policy for Exelon from 2012 to 2018.

Daniel L. Eggers(Date: 2022 February)

Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

Daniel Eggers is executive vice president and chief financial officer of Constellation. He previously served as senior vice president of corporate finance for Exelon and was a managing director at Credit Suisse.

Bryan P. Wright(Date: 2022 February)

Senior Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer

Bryan Wright is senior vice president and chief accounting officer of Constellation. He previously served as senior vice president and corporate controller for Exelon.

James McHugh(Date: 2022 February)

Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer

James McHugh is executive vice president and chief commercial officer of Constellation. He previously served as CEO of Constellation (Exelon's retail and wholesale business) and has held various leadership roles in trading and portfolio management.

David Rhoades(Date: 2022 February)

Executive Vice President and Chief Nuclear Officer

David Rhoades is executive vice president and chief nuclear officer of Constellation. He previously served as senior vice president of operations for Exelon Generation and has over 30 years of experience in the nuclear industry.
